title: The Present Continuous
summary: إزاي نتكلم عن حاجة بتحصل دلوقتي أو مؤقتة أو بتتغير في سوق الشغل بـ am / is / are + verb-ing.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: We use the **present continuous** to describe actions happening **right now**, **temporary** situations, and **current trends**. It is useful for discussing how the modern workplace is changing.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن الزمن اللي بنستخدمه لما نتكلم عن حاجة **بتحصل دلوقتي**، أو حاجة **مؤقتة** الفترة دي، أو حاجة **بتتغير** في العالم حوالينا. في العربي بنقول: «أنا **بذاكر** دلوقتي»، «هو **بيعمل** تدريب الصيف ده»، «سوق الشغل **بيتغير**».

في الكتاب الدرس ده موجود في **Book 2 · Unit 8: Pathways to Progress**، جزء **Grammar Focus: The Present Continuous Tense** (صفحة 77-78)، في موضوع **التعليم الفني (vocational education)** وسوق العمل. وبييجي تاني في **Consolidation Review D**، وفي الـ Speaking (لازم تقول جملتين على الأقل بالـ present continuous)، وفي الـ blog post بتاع «My Vocational Dream».
الفكرة ببساطة: «بيـ… دلوقتي / الفترة دي»

text: Form: **am / is / are + verb-ing**. The verb **be** changes with the subject, and the main verb always ends in **-ing**.

blocks.text: الزمن ده مكوّن من **حتتين** لازم يبقوا مع بعض دايمًا:

items: **am / is / are** (فعل مساعد بيتغير حسب الفاعل).
**الفعل + ing** (الفعل الأساسي).

blocks.text: لو نقصت أي حتة منهم الجملة تبقى غلط. ✗ The students learning. ✗ The students are learn. ✓ The students **are learning**.

rows: Sara **is preparing** for her job interview.
**you / we / they** / اسم جمع / اتنين بـ and
Ahmed and Ali **are attending** a training course.

blocks.text: القواعد والأشكال

rows: Employers **are looking** for candidates with strong soft skills.
أصحاب الشغل بيدوروا على ناس عندها مهارات شخصية قوية.
Our teachers **aren't teaching** through lectures only.
المدرسين مش بيشرحوا بالمحاضرات بس. (isn't / aren't / I'm not)
**Are** you **developing** your communication skills this term?
إنت بتطوّر مهارات التواصل بتاعتك الترم ده؟
Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.
Is Omar working today? — **Yes, he is.**

blocks.title: خلي بالك
blocks.text: في الإجابة القصيرة بالإثبات **مانختصرش**: ✓ Yes, he **is**. ✗ Yes, he's.
إزاي نكتب الفعل + ing؟ (قواعد الإملاء)

text: Most verbs just add **-ing**. Some verbs change their spelling first.

rows: فعل قصير: حرف ساكن + حرف متحرك واحد + حرف ساكن
الـ y تفضل زي ما هي.

blocks.text: خلي بالك: الأفعال الطويلة اللي الضغط مش على آخرها مابنكررش آخر حرف: develop ← **developing**، visit ← **visiting**، open ← **opening**. (وفي الإنجليزي البريطاني بنكتب travel ← **travelling**.)
إمتى نستخدمه؟ (4 استخدامات)

text: 1. Actions happening **now**. 2. **Temporary** situations. 3. **Current trends** and changes. 4. **Fixed future plans** (arrangements).

blocks.text: الكتاب بيركز على أول 3 استخدامات. والرابع مهم جدًا وهتقابله كتير:

rows: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
currently, this term, this week, this summer, these days
She **is currently completing** an internship at a local company.
حاجة بتتغير أو بتزيد أو بتقل
nowadays, increasingly, more and more, these days
The job market **is changing** faster than ever before.
I**'m starting** my training course **next Sunday**.

items.en: Look! The trainees **are repairing** the solar panels on the roof.
items.ar: Look! معناها إن الحاجة بتحصل قدامنا دلوقتي.

items.en: Many young Egyptians **are choosing** technical schools these days.
items.ar: **trend**: شباب مصريين كتير بيختاروا المدارس الفنية الأيام دي.

items.en: This term, our school **is offering** several new career-based activities.
Mona **is working** at a car factory this summer, but she usually **studies** in Cairo.
items.ar: شغل مؤقت الصيف ده (is working)، وعادة دايمة (studies).

items.en: Technology **is creating** new jobs that did not exist ten years ago.
Employers **are increasingly asking** for teamwork and adaptability.
items.ar: increasingly = «بشكل متزايد»: كلمة مثالية مع الـ trends.

items.en: Some students **aren't attending** the workshop today because they have an exam.
**Are** you **developing** any new skills at the moment?
We **are meeting** the factory manager on Thursday.
The demand for electricians **is growing** in new cities like New Capital.

blocks.text: Present Continuous ولا Present Simple؟

text: The **present simple** is for **habits, routines, facts** and **permanent** situations. The **present continuous** is for **now**, **temporary** situations and **changes**.

blocks.text: ده أهم فرق في الدرس، وهتلاقيه في الامتحان كتير:

rows: حاجة دايمة: My father **works** as a mechanic.
مؤقت: My father **is working** in Aswan this month.
كلمات: always, usually, often, every day, sometimes, never
كلمات: now, at the moment, currently, this week, these days, increasingly

items.en: Hany **repairs** cars for a living. Today he **is repairing** a bus.
items.ar: شغله الدايم تصليح عربيات (repairs)، النهارده بالذات بيصلّح أتوبيس (is repairing).

items.en: Engineers usually **work** in offices, but these engineers **are working** on site this week.

blocks.text: أفعال مابتجيش في الـ Continuous (Stative Verbs)

text: Some verbs describe **states**, not actions: feelings, thoughts and possession. We do not usually use them in the continuous form.

blocks.text: فيه أفعال بتعبّر عن **حالة** أو **إحساس** أو **رأي** أو **ملكية**، مش «حركة» بتحصل. الأفعال دي عادة **مابناخدش معاها -ing** حتى لو بنتكلم عن دلوقتي:

rows: know, believe, understand, think (= رأي), remember, mean
I **know** the answer now. ✗ I am knowing
like, love, hate, prefer, want, need
She **wants** to be a nurse. ✗ She is wanting
He **has** a small workshop. ✗ He is having a workshop
seem, look like, sound, smell, taste

blocks.text: بعض الأفعال ليها معنيين، فممكن تيجي في الاتنين:

items.en: I **am thinking** about my future career.
items.ar: think = بفكر (عملية في دماغي دلوقتي) ← continuous.

items.en: Omar **is having** lunch with his team.

blocks.text: إزاي نستخدمه في الكلام والكتابة

text: In presentations, blog posts and reports about careers, the present continuous helps you describe **what is happening in the job market now** and **what you are doing to prepare**.

blocks.text: في الـ Speaking والـ blog post الكتاب بيطلب منك جملتين على الأقل بالـ present continuous. أسهل طريقة إنك تتكلم عن **trends في سوق الشغل** وعن **اللي إنت بتعمله دلوقتي علشان تجهز نفسك**. شوف المثال ده:

text: Egypt **is building** new cities, factories and solar farms, so the country **is looking** for skilled technicians more than ever. Because of this, I **am studying** renewable energy at a technical school. This term, my classmates and I **are installing** small solar panels at our school, and we **are learning** how to solve real problems as a team.

blocks.text: لاحظ: **is building / is looking** = trends في البلد. **am studying** = حاجة مؤقتة الفترة دي. **are installing / are learning** = الترم ده (this term).

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ The students **is** learning new skills. ← ✓ The students **are** learning … (جمع = are)
✗ The students are **learn** new skills. ← ✓ The students are **learning** … (لازم ing)
✗ Sara **preparing** for her interview. ← ✓ Sara **is preparing** … (لازم is)
✗ Ahmed and Ali **is** attending a course. ← ✓ Ahmed and Ali **are** attending … (اتنين = are)
✗ I **am knowing** the answer. ← ✓ I **know** the answer. (know حالة)
✗ She is **makeing** a cake. ← ✓ She is **making** … (نشيل الـ e)
✗ Many schools **are developing now** stronger links **this year**. ← ✓ Many schools **are developing** stronger links this year.
✗ **Is** the students preparing? ← ✓ **Are** the students preparing?

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: دوّر على **الفاعل**: مفرد ← is، جمع أو اتنين بـ and ← are، I ← am.
استبعد أي اختيار **ناقص**: من غير am/is/are أو من غير ing.
فيه **now / at the moment / currently / this term / these days / increasingly**؟ غالبًا present continuous.
فيه **every day / usually / always**؟ غالبًا present simple.
الفعل **حالة** (know, want, need, like, believe)؟ استبعد -ing.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Which sentence is grammatically correct?**

text: a. The trainer are showing us the new machine.
b. The trainer is show us the new machine.
c. The trainer is showing us the new machine.
d. The trainer showing us the new machine.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** ليه؟ The trainer مفرد ← **is**، والفعل لازم **-ing**. (a) are مع مفرد، (b) ناقصها ing، (d) ناقصها is.
**2) Choose the correct answer.**

text: More and more young people ______ technical careers these days.
a. chose now  b. chooses  c. is chosen  d. are choosing

blocks.text: **الإجابة: d.** ليه؟ **these days / more and more** = trend، وpeople جمع ← **are choosing**.
**3) Complete with the correct present continuous form of the verb in brackets.**

text: At the moment, Mostafa ______ (train) to become a professional chef.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: is training.** ليه؟ At the moment + فاعل مفرد ← is + training.
تدريب
**A. Complete the text with the correct present continuous form of the verb in brackets.**

text: This year, our technical school (1) ______ (run) a new programme with a local car company. At the moment, a group of students (2) ______ (visit) the factory, where they (3) ______ (learn) to use modern machines. My friend Kareem (4) ______ (not / study) theory only. He (5) ______ (practise) real tasks with the engineers. (6) ______ you ______ (think) of joining the programme next year?

items.q: 1. our technical school ______ (run)
items.a: **is running** — school مفرد، وrun بنكرر الـ n.

items.q: 2. a group of students ______ (visit)
items.a: **is visiting** — At the moment = دلوقتي، وa group مفرد ← is. (في الإنجليزي البريطاني are visiting مقبولة كمان لأن الـ group ناس كتير.)

items.q: 3. they ______ (learn)
items.a: **are learning** — they ← are.

items.q: 4. Kareem ______ (not / study)
items.a: **isn't studying / is not studying** — نفي، والـ y تفضل.

items.q: 5. He ______ (practise)
items.a: **is practising** — نشيل الـ e. (بالبريطاني practise فعل بـ s.)
**Are** you **thinking** — سؤال: Are + you + thinking (think = بتفكر في قرار، فعل مش رأي).

blocks.text: **B. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
7. Employers ______ for graduates with strong problem-solving skills.
a. is looking  b. are looking  c. are look  d. looking
items.a: **b. are looking** — Employers جمع + ing.

items.q:
8. The demand for skilled technicians ______ every year.
a. is increasing  b. are increasing  c. increasing  d. is increase
items.a: **a. is increasing** — The demand مفرد (مش technicians)، وtrend بيزيد.

items.q:
9. Listen! The instructor ______ the safety rules.
a. explains  b. is explaining  c. explain  d. are explaining
items.a: **b. is explaining** — Listen! = دلوقتي، والفاعل مفرد.

items.q:
10. Rana ______ her internship next Monday.
a. starting  b. is starting  c. are starting  d. start
items.a: **b. is starting** — ترتيب للمستقبل متفق عليه.

items.q:
11. I ______ what you mean about soft skills.
a. am understanding  b. understanding  c. understand  d. am understand
items.a: **c. understand** — understand فعل حالة (state)، مابياخدش ing.

items.q:
12. My uncle usually ______ in a hotel, but this month he ______ on a cruise ship.
a. works / works  b. is working / works  c. works / is working  d. working / is working
items.a: **c. works / is working** — usually ← عادة دايمة (simple). this month ← مؤقت (continuous).

blocks.text: **C. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
13. a. The students is building a small robot.
b. The students are building a small robot.
c. The students are build a small robot.
d. The students building a small robot.
items.a: **b** — جمع ← are + building.

items.q:
14. a. Is the engineers testing the new system?
b. Are the engineers test the new system?
c. Are the engineers testing the new system?
d. The engineers testing the new system?
items.a: **c** — سؤال: Are + فاعل جمع + testing.

items.q:
15. a. Nada isn't working today because she is ill.
b. Nada not working today because she is ill.
c. Nada isn't work today because she is ill.
d. Nada aren't working today because she is ill.
items.a: **a** — نفي: isn't + working.

items.q:
16. a. We are planing a visit to a solar energy farm.
b. We are planning a visit to a solar energy farm.
c. We is planning a visit to a solar energy farm.
d. We planning a visit to a solar energy farm.
items.a: **b** — plan ← planning (نكرر الـ n)، وwe ← are.

blocks.text: **D. Present simple or present continuous? Put the verb in brackets in the correct form.**

items.q: 17. Nowadays, more and more young people ______ (choose) careers in technology.
items.a: **are choosing** — Nowadays + more and more = trend.

items.q: 18. Adel ______ (teach) electronics at our school. He has taught there for ten years.
items.a: **teaches** — شغله الدايم (حقيقة)، مش مؤقت.

items.q: 19. Be quiet, please. The trainees ______ (take) a practical test.
items.a: **are taking** — بيحصل دلوقتي (Be quiet).

items.q: 20. Carpenters ______ (need) patience and careful hands.
items.a: **need** — حقيقة عامة + need فعل حالة.

blocks.text: **E. Find the mistake and correct it. Then write as asked.**

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: The trainees practising the new skills now.
items.a: practising ← **are practising**: The trainees **are practising** the new skills now. — كان ناقصها are (trainees جمع).

items.q: 22. Find and correct the mistake: I am wanting to become a nurse because I like helping people.
items.a: am wanting ← **want**: I **want** to become a nurse … — want فعل حالة.

items.q: 23. Make the sentence negative: Our school is offering cooking workshops this term.
items.a: Our school **isn't offering / is not offering** cooking workshops this term.

items.q: 24. Make a question about the words in bold: Hoda is learning **graphic design**.
items.a: **What is Hoda learning?** — Wh- + is + فاعل + learning.

items.q: 25. Write TWO sentences about how the job market in Egypt is changing. Use the present continuous.
items.a: مثال: Egypt **is investing** in renewable energy, so companies **are looking** for more solar technicians. At the same time, many factories **are using** smart machines, so workers **are learning** digital skills. — trends بكلمات زي so / at the same time.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: التركيب: **am / is / are + verb-ing**، ولازم الحتتين مع بعض.
I ← **am**، مفرد ← **is**، جمع أو اتنين بـ and ← **are**.
بنستخدمه لـ: **دلوقتي** / **مؤقت** (this term, currently) / **trends** (nowadays, increasingly) / **مواعيد متفق عليها**.
العادة والحقيقة الدايمة ← **present simple** مش continuous.
أفعال الحالة (know, want, need, like, believe, understand) **مابتاخدش -ing** عادة.
